name: BeOS
description: A yellow-tabbed window on a blue desktop, with the Deskbar in the corner: its menu opens the scene list, the tray with the clock the frame's page, and the list below it the scene and its settings. On a Pi or an ESP32 every scene opens in a window of its own, listed in the Deskbar.

beos.name: BeOS
beos.description: A yellow-tabbed window on a blue desktop, with the Deskbar in the corner: its menu opens the scene list, the tray with the clock the frame's page, and the list below it the scene and its settings. On a Pi or an ESP32 every scene opens in a window of its own, listed in the Deskbar.

name: Classic Mac
description: A black-and-white Macintosh of 1991 around each scene: a menu bar with the screen's rounded corners, and a pinstriped window on the grey desktop. File opens a scene and its info, the clock the frame's page; the close box closes it, the gear box opens its settings. On a Pi or an ESP32 every scene opens in a window of its own: a double click rolls one up to its title bar.

classicMac.name: Classic Mac
classicMac.description: A menu bar and a pinstriped window around each scene, in black and white: File opens a scene and its info, the clock the frame's page. On a Pi or an ESP32 every scene opens in a window of its own, the frame's own apps are icons down the desktop's right, and a double click on a title bar rolls its window up.

name: Commander
description: A two-panel file commander in blue and cyan: the scene in one panel with its path at the top, the function keys along the bottom for the frame's page, the scene list, a full view, the scene's settings and the frame's own apps. On a Pi or an ESP32 the other panel runs a second scene at the same time: tap it or press Tab to switch, F5 to swap them.

commander.name: Commander

name: macOS
description: A menu bar, a window and a Dock around each scene: the menu and the Dock open the scene list and its settings, the traffic lights close, hide or unframe the window, and the clock opens the frame's page. On a Pi or an ESP32 every scene opens in a window of its own, with the frame's scenes in the Dock.

macos.name: macOS
macos.description: A menu bar, a window and a Dock around each scene: the menu and the Dock open the scene list and its settings, the traffic lights close, hide or unframe the window, and the clock opens the frame's page. On a Pi or an ESP32 every scene opens in a window of its own, with the frame's scenes in the Dock.

name: NeXTSTEP
description: The main menu down the left, a window with a black title bar, and the Dock down the right, in four greys that look the same on a screen, a grey panel and black-and-white e-paper. The Dock's mark opens the scene list and its clock the frame's page; Info opens the scene's settings. On a Pi or an ESP32 every scene opens in a window of its own, with the frame's scenes in the Dock.

nextstep.name: NeXTSTEP
nextstep.description: NeXTSTEP around each scene: the main menu, a window with a resize bar, and the Dock with the frame's scenes, the NeXT ellipsis under the ones not running. On a Pi or an ESP32 every scene opens in a window of its own.

name: Tiling
description: Every scene opened tiled on the desktop and running at once: the one with the focus large on the left, the others in a column beside it. On a Pi or an ESP32; elsewhere a bar above the scene.

tiling.name: Tiling
tiling.description: Every scene opened tiled on the desktop and running at once: the one with the focus large on the left, the others in a column beside it. On a Pi or an ESP32; elsewhere a bar above the scene.

name: Windows 98
description: A gray taskbar below each scene: Start opens the scene list, the gear its settings, and the tray with the signal, the battery and the clock the frame's. On a Pi or an ESP32 it is a desktop: every scene opened is a window, all running at once, moved, sized, maximized or full screen with the mouse.

windows98.name: Windows 98

name: Bottom bar
description: A bar below each scene with the date, the time, the Wi-Fi signal and the battery.

bottomBar.name: Bottom bar
bottomBar.description: A bar below each scene with the date, the time, the Wi-Fi signal and the battery.

name: E-reader
description: An e-reader's page around each scene: its name, the clock and the battery at the top, and a footer with its place in the frame's list, the time left in the day and a line that fills as the day goes. Tap the name for the scene list, the clock for the frame's page, and the footer's left or right half to turn to the scene before or after.

name: Front page
description: A newspaper masthead above each scene, with the date and the name of the scene under the title.

frontPage.name: Front page

name: Gallery wall
description: The scene hangs on a wall in a thin dark frame with a white mat, with a small museum label beside it.

name: Polaroid
description: A print with a wide white border: the scene is the photo, and its name is written along the bottom.

name: Side rail
description: A rail beside each scene with the time, the date, the Wi-Fi signal and the battery.

name: Teletext
description: A teletext page around each scene: a header with the page number, the date and the clock, the scene's name in a colored band, and the four Fastext links at the bottom. Red and green go to the scene before and after, yellow to the index, cyan to the scene's settings, and the clock to the frame's page.

name: Terminal
description: A shell prompt above each scene and a status line below it. Tap the prompt for the scene list and the status line for the frame settings.
